name: Minimal Tyrannosaurus
body:
Minimal Tyrannosaurus
CR 5

XP 1,600
Variant tyrannosaurus
N Small animal
Init +7; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +37

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 16, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +6 natural, +1 size)
hp 81 (18d8)
Fort +9, Ref +16, Will +10

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +19 (1d6+6/19-20 plus grab)
Special Attacks swallow whole (1d6+3 damage, AC 17, 11 hp)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 21, Con 11, Int 2, Wis 15, Cha 10
Base Atk +13; CMB +15 (+19 grapple); CMD 30
Feats Bleeding Critical, Critical Focus, Diehard, Endurance, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +5 (+9 to jump), Perception +37; Racial Modifiers +8 Perception
SQ powerful bite Languages –

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Powerful Bite (Ex)

This creature applies twice its Strength bonus to bite damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forest and plains
Organization solitary, pair, or pack (3–6)
Treasure none

Minimals are small versions of normally Medium, Huge or Large sized animals and beasts. Any animal or generally animal-like beast (GM’s discretion) can become a minimal.

Dinosaurs and their ilk are most commonly found as minimals on isolated islands where entire miniature eco-systems can be found.
